question: At what sweep speed does frame extraction stop returning a usable hero and start losing items — with the room, the lighting and the evidence held fixed?
one_way_note: This is the one degradation axis that exists only in video and cannot be studied with any number of stills. It is a controlled ladder, not a claim about how fast real owners move.

controlled_design.invalidation_rule: If any two rungs differ in framing, path or contents beyond the speed of travel, the ladder is void and must be regenerated. A rung that traverses less of the room than its neighbours is not a slower rung, it is a different clip.

clips.camera: start on the reference framing at the doorway and pivot left to right across the whole cloakroom, coming to rest on the basin wall; deliberate and slow, as if being careful, with only faint handheld wobble
intended_negatives: mirror reflection is not a stain

clips.camera: start on the reference framing at the doorway and pivot left to right across the whole cloakroom, coming to rest on the basin wall; an ordinary unhurried pace with the natural handheld wobble of a phone held in one hand
intended_negatives: mirror reflection is not a stain

clips.camera: start on the reference framing at the doorway and pivot left to right across the whole cloakroom, coming to rest on the basin wall; a hurried impatient pace with pronounced handheld wobble and visible motion blur through the middle of the move
intended_negatives: mirror reflection is not a stain

gold.scored_by: for each rung report the IQA score distribution of extracted frames, the selected hero, item recall, false-item rate, and the number of frames curate.py had to discard to reach its budget; the reportable result is the shape of the curve across rungs, not any single rung's absolute number
gold.watch_for: the failure docs/18 names by example - a hero that is a blurred close-up of nothing. If the hurried rung's hero is unusable while its item recall holds, hero selection and item extraction degrade at different speeds, and they need separate frame budgets.
